exl3.harness_note: Hashes of the committed scripts. The first-pass held-out runs used exl3_heldout.py 021900a9... and their comparisons exl3_compare.py 3c301b24... (a float comparison; every exactness result agrees with the runs' raw-byte SHA-256s). Every second-pass (v2) run used the committed exl3_heldout.py (47821e8f...). The timing sessions' script versions are in timing.json's identity.script.

exl3_v2.note: Second harness version: every prefill row recorded, the reconstruction GEMM choice and the mapped cuBLAS libraries recorded, optional per-layer capture. v2-*-cublas138 preloaded cuBLAS 13.8.0.4 but PyTorch's 13.1.1 stayed mapped too, so it is superseded by v2-*-cublas138b, which bind-mounts 13.8.0.4 over PyTorch's files.

exl3_v3.note: Third pass: fifteen legitimate arms (frozen EXL3-G, four retunings, GEMV on, cuBLAS 13.8.0.4, five upstream alternative implementations of norm, RoPE and attention, all_torch with cuBLAS 13.8.0.4, and the native-like ggml_ops arm with and without it) and seven injected faults, all captured with K/V after the single-token steps (v3-*); per-phase memory (mem-*); cuBLAS-logged plan runs (plan-*). Variants and faults run with EXL3_BC_ATTN=0. The harness grew between runs; each run records its own harness_sha256.
